name: IEMOCAP: Interactive Emotional Dyadic Motion Capture Database
description: The IEMOCAP database is an interactive emotional dyadic motion capture dataset recorded at the Speech Analysis and Interpretation Laboratory (SAIL) at USC. It contains approximately 12 hours of audiovisual data (video, audio, facial motion capture, text transcripts) from 10 actors rehearsing scripts and improvising emotional scenarios.
